notes.title: [v0.30.20] Beta May Big Update and August Update Plan
notes.content:
[h3]Monthly Big Updates Small Updates Promise[/h3][p]While it's been said that the VUP Simulator has been defer, it ends here now! Every month there will be a big content update and several small updates (bug) fixes and so on!

[/p][h2]Multilingualization[/h2][p]I'm sorry to say that the game is still in the early to mid stages of development, and a lot of the text has not been written. In addition, this system is actually earlier than the table favor, the translation structure is basically not. So I guess we'll have to wait until the preview stage (it's still in beta) to see if we'll be able to implement multilingualism.
In the future, there will definitely be multi-language, currently has access to multi-language plug-ins (table favor with the same model), will slowly access multi-language.

[/p][h2]June Updates[/h2][h3]June Update: Nili Commenting System[/h3][p]Nili now supports a commenting system, and with the addition of the Smart Lolis AI, both player and NPC videos will now have comments![/p][p]fun[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/95cdfb1f33b32aa31907740d16d655c5c1f88fdc.png"][/img][/p][p]no fun[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/724128a1840e002db6f6c444fbd8a6cd36e1c8ad.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And it will calculate the hidden score according to the title and description, if you post a video, you like to keep the default time name (2200-01-01), now there will be a poor video plays and data[/p][p]Canceled - Event AI Generation: Since the event system is going to be redone, and the AI generated events are actually mediocre, it's better to let the planner write them. Event related production has been canceled.[/p][h2]June Minor Updates[/h2][h3]Nili Video provides a display of video duration and resolution.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/ab8472b7ceceb2afad5f3953038107a1dad0b6f2.png"][/img][/p][p]Improved some of the UI alerts.[/p][p]Popup alerts for hunger/sleep deprivation[/p][p]Drug related implementation and support[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/7665eea87293e3b40b363ee4ea6bddaeaafb31e1.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Optimize skip logic: auto terminate and auto sleep[/b][/p][p]Fixed the error that may be caused by missing pictures[/p][p]Updated file browser to support viewing attributes[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/274fd61d1e21e469a9e1e71f6130b6f80f7d70a4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Attribute Viewing Support:[/b] Items. Video,Food,L2D[/p][p]Add all food column, you can see all the food you have.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/d14537348f40c0dedae2b8c3f04610f9423922ad.png"][/img][/p][p]Fix NILI bug that generates poor reviews[/p][p]Nili review interface[/p][p]Update review extraction user logic[/p][p][/p][h2]July Update Program[/h2][h3]July Update: Love Learning[/h3][p]A lot of people have told me that the short video editing in VE Clips doesn't work, is it because they haven't done it, but it's just that their character attributes don't meet the requirements.[/p][p]Now with Love Learning, players can learn a variety of skills through classes, and be able to use a variety of high-end editing skills and eloquence and other functions.[/p][h3]July Minor Updates.[/h3][p][b]Bug fixes:[/b] For example, I've heard that there are problems with the old artist's assignments, so I'll look into it later.[/p][p][b]Sound:[/b] Currently using my own sound effects or win11 sound mods, want to make some better sound effects, back to research to see[/p][p][b]Other:[/b] I don't think there's much to write about, if you have any suggestions for updates, please feel free to comment![/p][p] [/p][h2]Game Feedback[/h2][p]
The fourth round of testing is a bit of a game, but the content is very poor, the core gameplay (virtual tuber, etc.) has not been realized, please bear with me!
If you encounter bugs or errors, please contact customer service email service@exlb.net[/p]

notes.title: [v0.30.10] Beta May Big Update and June Update Plan
notes.content:
[h3]Monthly Big Updates Small Updates Promise[/h3]
While it's been said that the VUP Simulator has been goo, it ends here now! Every month there will be a big content update and several small updates (bug) fixes and so on!

[h2]Multilingualization[/h2]
I'm sorry to say that the game is still in the early to mid stages of development, and a lot of the text has not been written. In addition, this system is actually earlier than the table favor, the translation structure is basically not. So I guess we'll have to wait until the preview stage (it's still in beta) to see if we'll be able to implement multilingualism.
In the future, there will definitely be multi-language, currently has access to multi-language plug-ins (table favor with the same model), will slowly access multi-language.

[h2]May's update[/h2]
[h3]May's big update: Old Artist[/h3]
Old Painter is now complete (basic features are now loaded).
Here are some screenshots of the game: The Artist Page
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/841634da05363802e6fbd1997833347c6f2f69c4.png[/img]
Planning Progress View
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/7df72f128660a4c97f68762eb7afb87d05927443.png[/img]
Main page for all projects
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821782/6e50f0ed5bcac320f364b534808616f542d7fd3f.png[/img]
Players can now make appointments and improve their L2D risque models in the Veteran Artist
[h3]May Minor Updates[/h3]
Fixed bug where command line programs were not executed
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem that some software (Software Center) opens slowly and gets stuck.
[*] Changed to UI queue to reduce possible UI thread lag on low performance computers.
[*] Avatar generation consistency
[*] Bug fixes * 5
[*] Support for modifying table favor scaling and other settings
[*] Eating doesn't get stuck at the end and prevent you from doing other things
[*] Extremely large part-window performance boost (switched to Visual virtual loading to reduce game performance requirements)
[/list]

[h2]June update program[/h2]
[h3]June Update: Accessing the Smart Lolis AI Server[/h3]
My new graphics server arrived, the one used to train ChatVPet table pets to talk.
However, at present there is no need to train, and I intend to use it to improve gameplay. When there is enough data, it can also be changed to offline keyword/machine learning judgment.
Scope of access and examples
[list]
[*] nilinli video: determine if the title and introduction of the video is funny/interesting/attractive, etc., and decide how much the video will be played.
[*] Events: randomly generate events based on difficulty, try it first, it's fun!
[/list]
[h3]Small update in June: Improvements to the file manager[/h3].
Foods can be viewed in all food items.
You can simply see the item information from the sidebar, so you don't have to use the attribute panel.
Make a whole lot of medicines, and add some health to them.

[h2]Game Feedback[/h2]

The fourth round of testing is a bit of a game, but the content is very poor, the core gameplay (virtual tuber, etc.) has not been realized, please bear with me!
If you encounter bugs or errors, please contact customer service email service@exlb.net

notes.title: 第三轮半公开测试! 将在12月2日进行
notes.content:
[h2]第三轮半公开测试! 将在12月2日进行[/h2]

又经过了2个月的开发, UI,商城和电脑配件和体力状态系统迎来了大更新. 预计在12月2日进行第三轮半公开测试,之前的测试名额将不会回收.
每次测试均代表有重大内容/功能更新. 如果没有获得这次的测试名额,也可以参与下一次或者未来的公开测试

[h2]预计开放功能[/h2]
[list]
[*]上一轮测试的所有内容
[*]全新UI界面
[*]新的精力系统 - 食物+睡眠 复合体力管理
[*]新的状态系统 - 不吃饭不睡觉生病等都会降低状态, 更好的状态消耗更少的体力和提高工作质量
[*]更好买商城 - 购买物品 (食物/药品/电脑配件)
[*]我的电脑 - 查看和更改电脑配置
[/list]

[h2]全新UI界面[/h2]
UI界面焕然一新! 特意聘请了知名WPFUI开源库作者 末城via 重新改版了UI界面
除了全新UI以外,还支持自定义修改窗体大小. 无需在默认窗体/全屏化二选一

[h2]新的精力系统[/h2]
精力系统全新改版, 精力现在一分为二,体力+睡眠模式更加合理
[list]
[*]体力: 通过食物恢复
[*]睡眠: 通过睡觉恢复
[/list]
实际精力取二者最小值, 这样就不会出现只需要睡觉就可以不吃东西的不合理行为
同时现在精力消耗可以在菜单栏中看到, 玩家可以了解是什么在消耗精力以及消耗的速度如何

[h2]新的状态系统[/h2]
新增状态系统, 更好的状态消耗更少的体力和提高工作质量
吃更好的东西和休息/摸鱼 会提高状态, 而长时间工作,长时间不睡觉,生病等会降低状态
该系统让有钱的玩家无法通过疯狂的喝咖啡导致长时间不睡觉的不合理行为
不过不必担心新系统导致游戏过于复杂,根据设计,该状态基本上约等于无感知,只有少部分事件/食物等会影响到人物状态.并且状态均有指定的持续时间,持续时间过后状态会自动消失(除了不睡觉)

[h2]新的程序已上线[/h2]
[h3]更好买商城[/h3]
更好买商城现已开放,玩家可以在商城中购买各种物品,包括但不限于 电脑配件,食品饮料等
[h3]我的电脑 [/h3]
现在可以在我的电脑中查看电脑配件信息,并且支持修改电脑名字,更换配件等功能


[h2]开放名额[/h2]
第三轮半公开测试将会开放500名玩家参与测试
Steam测试发放机制均由Steam进行, 意味着是随机且开发者没法知道玩家名称和信息
在商店页面 [加入 虚拟主播模拟器 Playtest] 点击 请求访问权限 即可参与测试(正式发放在12/02上午10点由Steam随机抽取) 

[h2]游戏反馈[/h2]

第三轮测试算是有点游戏的样子了,但是内容也非常贫乏, 核心玩法(虚拟主播等) 也没有实现, 请多多包涵
如遇到BUG或错误 欢迎联系客服 邮件service@exlb.net
如果希望提供建议或者意见 欢迎联系我们或前往虚拟主播模拟器贴吧发帖

虚拟主播模拟器QQ群: 430081239

[h2]一些游戏截图[/h2]
饼!
